SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q13. In which one of the following states is the bamboo drip irrigation system prevalent?  
(A) Rajasthan  
(B) Himachal Pradesh  
(C) West Bengal  
(D) Meghalaya

Answer / Solution:
In which one of the following states is the bamboo drip irrigation system 
prevalent? 
(D) Meghalaya 
Reasoning: It is a 200-year-old system prevalent in Meghalaya.
